decisions.reason: Specialized spraying system remains aligned with core expertise and is still relatively early in its market lifecycle.
Dedicated webpage and close fit to the established pump range signal strong commitment and very low dropout risk.
Product line with multiple models leverages core material transfer competence and warrants continued development.
More adjacent fire protection application adds some risk, but it still builds on flow monitoring know-how, so keep with moderate caution.
New but close to established hydraulic spraying systems, so keep while market acceptance develops.
